item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local socket): "Implement `retry_budget.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Goal: retry_budget.py implements exactly the API documented in SPEC.md in the repository root.
Acceptance criteria:
- Every documented function, class and parameter is implemented with the documented signature and behaviour; nothing undocumented is removed or renamed.
- Every error case listed in SPEC.md raises the specified exception type, with the specified conditions; boundary values (zero, limits, exhausted budget, invalid inputs) follow the spec.
- Focused tests added (standard library unittest or pytest-free) covering each error path and boundary case in SPEC.md; existing tests kept passing.
- Standard library only; no new dependencies.
- Keep functions under ~60 lines, validate inputs at the boundary, never swallow exceptions.
- Commit the work on the local branch with a clear message (ship mode is local; do not push). Use the repository's configured git identity only; no attribution lines beyond the Co-Authored-By line required by the operator's attribution rule.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

pr.body:
Approach: retry_delay validates every argument first (built-in int only, minimums, ValueError), then returns None if attempt >= max_attempts. Backoff is min(cap, base*2**(attempt-1)) computed via a bit-length shortcut so huge attempts never allocate a large power; zero base returns 0. Retry-After is a floor not limited by cap. Retry is refused when elapsed+delay >= budget; delay is never shortened.

Key files: retry_budget.py (validation and backoff helpers), test_retry_budget.py (existing 3 tests kept, 34 added covering each error path, attempt and budget boundaries, saturation, Retry-After floor).

Checks: unittest 37 OK; py_compile -W error OK; no lines over 79 columns. No linter installed. Reviewer brute-force over 190,080 argument combinations against the spec formula: 0 mismatches (temp copy, not committed).

Assumptions: type errors raise ValueError, as SPEC.md says for invalid values (not TypeError). Subclasses of int such as IntEnum are rejected, matching 'built-in int'. No commit-message attribution line was added, per the stage contract and CLAUDE.md.
pr.summary: made retry_delay follow SPEC.md. now validates all args, caps backoff, applies Retry-After floor, and refuses retries past budget. before: NotImplementedError stub, 3 failing tests; now: 37 tests pass.
